verses.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A Song. God [is] unto us a place of refuge and strength, a help in distress surely to be found.

segments.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A Song. God [is] unto us a place of refuge and strength, a help in distress surely to be found.

verses.text: Upon thus we will not fear, with the changing of the earth, and with the shaking of the mountains into the heart of the seas—

segments.text: Upon thus we will not fear, with the changing of the earth, and with the shaking of the mountains into the heart of the seas—

verses.text: [there is] a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the Holy Place of the dwelling of the Most High.

verses.text: God [is] within her; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the turn of the morning.

segments.text: God [is] within her; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the turn of the morning.

verses.text: The nations raged, the kingdoms were shaken; He has given forth with His voice; the earth melts.

verses.text: YHWH of Hosts [is] with us; a secure height for us [is] the God of Jacob. Selah

segments.text: YHWH of Hosts [is] with us; a secure height for us [is] the God of Jacob. Selah

verses.text: Come, see the works of YHWH, who has set devastation upon the earth.

segments.text: Come, see the works of YHWH, who has set devastation upon the earth.

verses.text: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; the bow He breaks, and the spear He cuts apart; the shields He burns in the fire.

verses.text: “Be still and know that I [am] God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
